name: codex-auto-resume
description: Resume VS Code Codex threads automatically after usage limits reset.

commands.title: Codex Auto Resume: Test Official Submit Bridge (Legacy)
Codex Auto Resume: Test Official UI IPC Bridge
Codex Auto Resume: Diagnose Official Codex Integration

codexAutoResume.enabled.description: Automatically resume a recently interrupted VS Code Codex thread after its usage limit resets.

codexAutoResume.resumePrompt.default: 继续。从中断处恢复，先检查当前工作区已有修改和上一轮状态，不要重复已经完成的工作。
codexAutoResume.resumePrompt.description: Prompt sent when the extension resumes an interrupted Codex thread.

codexAutoResume.pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to refresh Codex usage state while auto resume is enabled.

codexAutoResume.resetGraceSeconds.description: Extra delay after the reported reset time before resuming.

codexAutoResume.resumeStabilitySeconds.description: How long a resumed turn must remain in progress without a quota error before auto-resume considers it stable and disarms. Completed turns disarm immediately.

codexAutoResume.recentThreadMinutes.description: Only arm auto-resume for VS Code Codex threads updated within this many minutes. The default covers a full 5-hour quota window plus margin.

codexAutoResume.codexCommand.description: Optional Codex executable override. When empty, the binary bundled with the official openai.chatgpt extension is preferred.
